run_searched_lib_test: run the Boost.Build test script that validates searched library linking behavior via -l linker switch
test_searched_lib_basic_usage: test that the simplest usage of a searched library with name and search properties works correctly
test_searched_lib_unit_test_runtime_path: test that unit-test targets correctly add runtime paths to searched libraries
test_searched_lib_static_from_shared: test using a searched shared library from a static library with link property variants
test_searched_lib_regression_library_pro: test the regression fix where library property referring to searched-lib was mishandled on command line
